explanation: The closest match is Polynomial.hom_eval₂ (Mathlib/Algebra/Polynomial/Eval/Coeff.lean). It gives g (p.eval₂ f x) = p.eval₂ (g.comp f) (g x). The theorem here needs the extra identity g.comp (aeval a).toRingHom = (aeval (g a)).toRingHom as ring homomorphisms out of ℤ[X]. That identity is proved by ringHom_ext', RingHom.ext_int and simp, or by a comparable argument using aeval_algHom_apply. It is a separate step and goes beyond two short lines. I also looked for a direct lemma with this statement and found none.
